body:
Greptile Summary

This PR streamlines the test suite while strengthening retained behavioral coverage and fixture synchronization. - Consolidates overlapping serialization, rendering, query, lifecycle, and engine tests. - Replaces timing-based waits and silent platform returns with explicit synchronization and reported skips. - Makes map fixtures own launched coroutine work and synchronizes native style binding before declaring a load complete. - Adds stronger argument forwarding, pixel, query, cancellation, and repaint assertions.

Confidence Score: 5/5

The PR appears safe to merge; no actionable regressions or repository-rule violations remain. The changes since the previous review strengthen the overlapping-feature readiness condition without changing production behavior, and the full test-only changes preserve explicit lifecycle, synchronization, rendering, and cleanup contracts.

Important Files Changed

 | Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | lib/maplibre-compose/src/liveMapTest/kotlin/org/maplibre/compose/testing/MapFixture.kt | Extends the shared test contract with coroutine-scoped execution and explicit platform skip handling. | | lib/maplibre-compose/src/jsTest/kotlin/org/maplibre/compose/testing/GlJsMapFixture.kt | Moves asynchronous fixture work into structured concurrency and rejects unsupported browser capabilities explicitly. | | lib/maplibre-compose/src/maplibreNativeTest/kotlin/org/maplibre/compose/testing/MlnFfiMapFixture.kt | Synchronizes the loaded native style binding before marking the style ready. | | lib/maplibre-compose/src/liveMapTest/kotlin/org/maplibre/compose/map/MapQueryTest.kt | Replaces fixed frame pumping with positive rendered-feature readiness checks, including both overlapping sources. | | lib/maplibre-compose/src/maplibreNativeTest/kotlin/org/maplibre/compose/offline/MlnFfiOfflineRuntimeTest.kt | Retains explicit task-wake and shutdown-wake lifecycle coverage with deterministic synchronization. | | lib/maplibre-compose/src/maplibreNativeTest/kotlin/org/maplibre/compose/map/MlnFfiMapRepaintTest.kt | Strengthens repaint coverage with observable pixel-level rendering checks. |
